caveat: The wiki has no per-pair table for fused results: the rule is that the two balls' names and effects are combined. The only per-pair data are the evolution recipes below. Read via summarising fetch; spot-check.

fusion.inputs: 2 unfused level-3 balls: Base+Base, Evolved+Evolved, or Base+Evolved. The same ball cannot fuse with itself.
fusion.exclusion: If two balls can combine into an Evolved Ball, they cannot be fused, only evolved. Exception: pairs whose only common evolution needs 3+ balls (Nosferatu, Elemental) can be fused.
fusion.order: Fusion order follows acquisition order; it cannot be chosen manually.
fusion.result: Name and effects of both ingredients combined; stat/ability priority depends on the component balls. Order does not change function, but name and appearance may differ. Fusing frees a slot for a new ball (Fusion Reactor page).
named_results: Egg Sac X Poison and Poison X Egg Sac: same effects, same sprite
Spider Queen X Vampire Lord and Vampire Lord X Spider Queen: same effects, different sprites

ability_types.AOE: damages multiple targets; can apply Status Effect
ability_types.Spawn: creates clones, baby balls or summons; spawns can inherit abilities
ability_types.Status Effect: applies debuffs; cannot trigger other abilities

fusion.trigger_note: On-Shoot is listed as a trigger but is absent from the table. Radiation from Nuclear Bomb counts as a Damage effect.

evolution.rule: Evolved balls are made from 2 or more specific level-3 Base or Evolved balls in the Fusion Reactor. Order does not matter. 'Or' in a recipe means either set works. Some evolved balls can evolve again into other evolved balls (e.g. Sniper from Shotgun + Assassin); that further-evolution column was not in the text read.

recipes.ingredients: Vampire Lord + Spider Queen + Mosquito King (3 ingredients)
(Laser Horizontal or Laser Vertical) + (Poison or Cell)

fission_and_evolution_slots: Per the Fusion Reactor page: Fission grants random upgrade levels for balls or passives (gold if everything is maxed). Evolution turns the required level-3 items into an evolved ball or passive, freeing a slot.
